description: Whole-model F32 reference for the 2-layer, 2-head, head-dim-64 randomly-initialised GPT-2 ONNX graph.  Prefill at lengths 1/4/8/13, four cached decode steps, and cached-vs-full parity at every step.

sequence.note: TOKENS is tokenizer.encode(text). Prefill lengths are prefixes; decode tokens are TOKENS[13:17], so each cached step is compared with a full recomputation of the same prefix.
sequence.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Once upon a time, there was

tolerance_policy.argmax: A different argmax is a failure only when the reference top-two gap exceeds 2 * atol; ties inside the noise floor are not gated.
failure: NaN or Inf where the reference is finite
any element outside the elementwise bound
mean_abs above the stated bound (systematic bias)
tolerance_policy.sequence_scaling: For S > 16 multiply atol by sqrt(S/16); rtol is unchanged. The tiny-model fixtures stop at S=17, so the unscaled bound applies to every committed tensor.
